FEAT-3-S106.title: Clinical Trials Search Input/Output Schema Validation
FEAT-3-S106.description: Define and enforce Pydantic models for clinical trials search inputs (condition, location, radius) and outputs (trial metadata, locations, distance, duration) to ensure contract consistency.

FEAT-3-S107.title: EvaluateCare Facade Integration for Clinical Trials Search
FEAT-3-S107.description: Integrate clinical_trials_service into evaluate_care_facade to orchestrate validated input, invoke search logic, and return formatted results to the application layer.

FEAT-3-S108.title: Tool Router Registration for Clinical Trials Search
FEAT-3-S108.description: Register clinical trials search as an allowed tool in tool_router with proper input validation and routing to the EvaluateCare facade.

FEAT-3-S109.title: Clinical Trials Service Unit and Integration Tests
FEAT-3-S109.description: Implement unit tests for query construction, location parsing, and distance computation, plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow through facade and tool router.
